Overview

Herning is a city in Central Jutland with a population of 50,000. A textile and business hub in central Jutland, known for its art museum, exhibition center, and fashion industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
